title: Provenance screening for routine health-programme data: an instrument and two applications to WHO tuberculosis datasets
description:
Reproducible screens that distinguish, from the published file alone, which variables in a country-reported health dataset carry annual measurements and which carry carried-forward estimates or categorical status flags, and a vintage analysis that measures revision, restatement and imputation directly across dated releases.

Applied to 443 numeric variables across six WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme datasets; to India's national TB financing accounts from the India TB Report 2024; and to three archived releases of WHO's TB finance and utilisation data (2024-2026) together with WHO's processed files and code, decomposing WHO's published estimate of TB care spending by the provenance of its inputs.

Contains: the screening instrument and its tests; the vintage analysis (demos/d3_vintages.py); the archived public WHO input files as downloaded; a fetch script that downloads WHO's report-repository files from pinned commits and verifies their SHA-256 digests (those files carry no licence and are not redistributed); the full verification suite; and FINDINGS.md, a record of every verified result and every correction made during development.
